footnotes.text: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.50 GPA on all MUSC & MUED courses and a 2.00 cumulative GPA.

evidence.quote: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.50 GPA on all MUSC & MUED courses and a 2.00 cumulative GPA.

footnotes.text: 2. Some colleges require a minimum GPA for major courses. Courses indicated in this column are included in the major GPA for this program of study.

evidence.quote: 2. Some colleges require a minimum GPA for major courses. Courses indicated in this column are included in the major GPA for this program of study.

footnotes.text: 3. Students must declare a primary instrument upon acceptance into the program. Some ensembles require an audition for membership. Regulations for attendance at ensemble rehearsals & performances are different from regulations for class attendance. Members of ensembles are expected to be present at every rehearsal & performance, unless excused by the conductor. Students enrolling in an ensemble to fulfill a degree requirement must register for at least 1 credit hour. Ensemble requirements are as follows: Wind Instrument (6 semesters of MUSC 131 – Jazz Ensemble and 2 semesters of MUSC 130Z – Jazz Combo) or 2) Rhythm Section Instrument (2 semesters of MUSC 131 – Jazz Ensemble, 2 semesters of MUSC 130Z – Jazz Combo, and 4 semesters chosen from MUSC 135C, 131, 130Z).

footnotes.text: 4. Concentration Electives: Students must complete a minimum of 10 hours of concentration electives, including MUED 155 & 156, if needed. MUED 155 and 156 are not required if taking MUSC 111P for Piano as primary instrument or if a student passes the proficiency exam. Concentration electives include any MUED or MUSC courses (other than MUSC 103, 104, 105, 110, 113, 140, 203.

footnotes.text: 5. Applied Music must be completed satisfactorily for a minimum of 32 hours of credit.
